title: Fixed scheduled post times when changing site timezone
summary: Architecture: posts store a UTC publish instant and the site timezone defines its local wall time. Problem: rescheduling uses the timezone offsets today, even for posts in a different daylight-saving season. Solution: read each post in the old timezone, then keep that local wall time in the new timezone, using the scheduled date.
validation: Proposed listener fix. Cover winter versus summer, spring clock gaps and autumn overlaps using the existing timezone library policy. No new daylight-saving policy.
